en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a riverside port with several piers and moored ships along a wide river. On the right, a dirt road runs parallel to the water with horse-drawn carriages and a few small buildings. The riverbank is sloping, and industrial structures, chimneys, and boats are visible in the distance. Printed text identifies the scene as the port of Braila, and there is cursive handwriting over parts of the card.
